description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 music video prompt with attached video evidence from @ou_zhen599.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3音乐视频提示词。

prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 15-second, 16:9, cinematic photoreal image-to-video sequence based on <Picture 1>, unfolding entirely inside the same tropical ruin space: the ancient forecourt, shallow-water stone path, carved pillars, and the dark waterfall opening aligned on one continuous depth axis. Preserve the exact same adult female explorer throughout: same face, proportions, hairstyle, skin tone, mud marks, sweat sheen, outfit, holster, belt, accessories, and handgun. No location change, no exterior vista, no underground hall, no extra people. The tone is elegant, dangerous, sensual, and restrained, like a high-end adventure thriller. Her sensuality comes only from wet skin, collarbone, shoulder strap, breath, step rhythm, and lethal focus, never posing. She remains in motion throughout. The camera follows pseudo-one-take logic with hidden transitions only through reeds, vines, gun-body wipes, or her own body crossing frame. Light is late-morning tropical sun through canopy gaps, with strong side-back and rim-back highlights on damp hair, skin edges, straps, and gun metal, while the waterfall creates dense white mist. [Shot 2] At 00:00.000-00:02.000, begin immediately on her in a close wide-angle body-follow shot from her left-front at collarbone height, retreating smoothly with her wading step. The frame clearly holds damp collarbone, tight shoulder strap on wet skin, strands of wet hair along the neck, the slight rise and fall of controlled breathing, her right hand carrying the handgun low, and her legs cutting through shallow water. She never stops walking. With her left hand, she brushes one wet strand from the side of her neck back toward the ear. The opening feels sensual inside action: collarbone line, strap tension, breathing motion, wet hair against skin, but the emotional tone stays focused. Expression layer one is calm reconnaissance: brows straight with slight inward tension, eyes scan the ground then lift forward, lids slightly lowered, pupils stable, lips parted by a narrow line, breath short and controlled. She says quietly, throat-close: <d>[English] Too quiet.</d> [Shot 3] At 00:02.000, without a hard cut, use her arm and foreground vines as a natural wipe into a left-rear three-quarter medium-close follow shot. Carved pillars and vines cross the foreground. She lowers her body slightly and threads through two carved pillars without stopping, pushing vines and broad leaves aside with her left hand while the handgun stays low but ready in her right. Her emotion shifts from calm into mild doubt: the brow center gathers a little more, her gaze cuts from the stone path and pillar bases toward the waterfall direction, upper lids lift by a fraction, nostrils widen slightly, breathing speeds up while staying controlled, the lip line becomes thinner, and the jaw begins to set. Wet hair swings lightly with movement and plant contact. Leaves rebound, shedding bright backlit droplets. [Shot 4] At 00:05.000, move into a natural perspective from her right-rear at about waist height. She steps onto an ancient carved stone pattern under shallow water. First the water around her boot trembles, then a muted antique gold-cold light appears inside the wet grooves and races along the carved channels for about half a meter before weakening. This is the only supernatural-adjacent effect, and it must feel like an old stone system briefly waking, not neon or sci-fi. She performs a real stop reaction with weight: front foot plants, rear foot searches for support, knees flex, pelvis stabilizes, torso half-turns, and the handgun rises fast from thigh-level to chest-ready. Her expression enters sudden alertness: eyes snap into focus, brow center tightens in one short inward pull, lids open slightly, nostrils take one short intake, lips part for an instant and seal again, jaw locks. Water splashes outward and the glowing grooves cast broken reflections on wet stone before fading rapidly. [Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the camera tracks laterally along her right side in a medium-close profile, keeping her and the dark waterfall opening in the same perspective line. She does not stop. She moves two steps right along the stone pillar, her left hand dragging lightly across the damp carved wall to confirm the path, while the handgun rises and fully locks onto the black space behind the waterfall. Her emotion compresses into hunter-mode focus: gaze pinned ahead, blinking nearly gone, upper lids tightening, lower lids faintly engaged, pupils fixed on the opening, brow center inward but not lifted, nostrils carrying tension, lips sealed, mouth corners slightly downward, jaw visibly harder, and one tiny swallow in the throat. The waterfall spray becomes dense white particles in backlight. The opening remains only deep layered black, with no full animal shape, no face, no visible panther head. [Shot 6] At 00:11.000, shift into a pressure push-in from a half-body armed medium close toward a tighter shot containing her eyes, gun muzzle, shoulder line, and part of the collarbone, while preserving waterfall highlights and mist behind. She locks down her lower body, rear foot driving into the stone, center of gravity sinking, and the gun barrel aligning more precisely with the center of the dark opening. She seems to push herself into her own aim line. Her emotion reaches maximum alert pressure: eyes sharp and almost unblinking, brow slightly lowered inward for a colder lock, nostril tension increasing, lips compressed into a thinner line, jaw and masseter fully engaged. The handgun must feel heavy in wrist, forearm, shoulder, and collarbone line. [Shot 7] At 00:13.000, the camera stops pushing and holds a stable suspended composition. The foreground keeps only her three-quarter side-face silhouette and the handgun muzzle; the waterfall remains midground and the black opening stays in background. In the final two seconds, introduce only one new piece of information: at first the opening contains nothing readable, then only one black panther eye catches a trace of environmental light and returns a muted amber-gold reflection. The eye must not glow actively, must not look sci-fi, and must not read like a jewel; it is simply a wild animal eye catching light inside extreme darkness. The panther body stays hidden in shadow. No full panther face, no second eye, no leap, no attack motion. Water spray and mist continue to cross the frame. End on the suspended relationship: she is locking onto the darkness, and the darkness is looking back.

overall_soundscape: Use only realistic environmental and action sound. In the first half, emphasize shallow-water footsteps, leaves and vines brushing fabric and skin, low breathing, soft cloth friction, and subtle metal contact from the handgun. Add the muted resonance of her boot on carved stone and the brief inner-stone glow cue as a subtle old mineral hum, never electric. In the middle and late section, the waterfall rumble becomes dominant, with mist, damp stone, controlled breathing, and silence carrying the pressure. Let <d>[English] Too quiet.</d> sit low and throat-close. In the final two seconds there is no dialogue and no animal growl, only waterfall, suspended mist, and the pressure of silence around the revealed eye.

non_diegetic_music: Use no score or only an extremely faint low-frequency pressure bed beginning after the carved-stone activation. It must never overpower water, breath, leaves, or the final suspended reveal. The ending should remain tense, elegant, unresolved, and physically grounded rather than dramatic or explosive.
